name: Data Analysis with Pandas & NumPy
description: Essential data manipulation, cleaning, aggregation, time series analysis, and exploratory visualization using Python data libraries.

skills.name: NumPy ndarrays & Array Shapes
skills.description: Array creation (zeros, ones, arange, linspace), dtypes, and shape/reshape operations.

skills.name: Array Indexing, Slicing & Strides
skills.description: Multi-dimensional slicing, fancy indexing with integer arrays, and boolean masks.

skills.name: Vectorized Math & Broadcasting Rules
skills.description: Element-wise arithmetic, universal functions (ufuncs), and automatic dimension expansion.

skills.name: NumPy Statistical Reductions
skills.description: Mean, std, median, percentiles, min/max along specific axes (axis=0, axis=1).

skills.name: Pandas Series & DataFrame Structures
skills.description: Labeled axes, indexes, columns, info(), describe(), and dtypes inspection.

skills.name: Reading & Writing CSV, Parquet & JSON
skills.description: read_csv, read_parquet, parse_dates, chunksize, and memory-efficient loading.

skills.name: Data Selection with .loc & .iloc
skills.description: Label-based vs position-based selection, scalar lookups with .at/.iat, and view vs copy warnings.

skills.name: Handling Missing Data & Null Imputation
skills.description: isna(), dropna(), fillna(method='ffill'), interpolate(), and mean/median imputers.

skills.name: Column Math, .apply() & .map()
skills.description: Vectorized string/numeric column ops, lambda functions, and assign().

skills.name: Boolean Filtering & Query Expressions
skills.description: Bitwise operators (&, |, ~), isin(), between(), and df.query() syntax.

skills.name: GroupBy & Split-Apply-Combine
skills.description: Grouping by multiple keys, named aggregations with agg(), and transform().

skills.name: Merging, Joining & Concatenation
skills.description: Inner/Outer/Left/Right merges, concat along rows/columns, and merge validation (1:1, 1:m).

skills.name: Pivot Tables, Stack & Melt
skills.description: pivot_table(), crosstab(), wide-to-long with pd.melt(), and multi-level indexes.

skills.name: Datetime Parsing & Time Series Resampling
skills.description: pd.to_datetime, DatetimeIndex, dt accessor, resample('M'), and rolling window calculations.

skills.name: Text Cleaning with .str Accessor
skills.description: Regex extraction (.str.extract), string splitting, stripping, and replacement.

skills.name: Data Visualization with Matplotlib & Seaborn
skills.description: Histograms, scatter plots, box plots, heatmaps, and subplots layout.

skills.name: EDA Workflow & Outlier Detection
skills.description: IQR method, Z-score thresholds, skewness, correlation matrices, and data distribution profiling.

skills.name: Regression Modeling & Trend Fitting
skills.description: Simple linear regression, R-squared goodness of fit, residual plots, and forecasting trends.
